text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President HosniMubarak arrives into Davos on Friday to attend the World Economic Forum. Mubarak will hold meetings at the margin of the gathering.
- Mubarak and U.S. President Bill Clinton will discuss in Washington on March 10 bilateral relations and the resumption of the Syrian-Israeli negotiaions.
- Mubarak receives Indonesian Minister of Research and Technology Jusuf Habibie.
- Agricultural banks make available 800 million pounds to finance small-scale projects.
-Iraq to take part in the Cairo World Fair next March, for the first time since 1990.
- Egypt denounces Israel's violations against Palestinian human rights.
